origins.locator: traverse: constant OCV/Rint stable root and SOC acceptance

limitations: Constant OCV/resistance, no thermal or SOC-dependent impedance.
Voltage-invariant source loss grid; optional conservative voltage-speed envelope.
A discharge shortfall refuses backward range rather than silently slowing the vehicle.
Auxiliaries may consume generated power even when battery charging is unavailable.
